Messages.Author: Peter D Bakija
Messages.Body:
If a vampire has a Changeling Skin Mask (which gives the possessor OBF), can
you play an Obfuscate discipline card on that vampire if they don't have
inherrent (non Mask enhanced) OBF already? I.e. if Dimple (with obf) has the
Mask, can I play an Obfuscate master on him anyways?

(this same question applies to, I guess, Hand of Conrad and the like as well)
